snippet.title: Canyons - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Canyons, a third-person action shooter developed by RedRuins Softworks. Players will explore a procedurally generated world to fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players. Command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world. Canyons is launching into Early Access in 2027 for PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
